---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect parsing, matching, packaging, or documentation
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Summary

Describe the incorrect behavior and its impact.

## Safe reproduction

Provide minimal synthetic input and exact commands. Never attach production evidence, credentials, personal data, or active malware.

## Expected and actual behavior

Explain what should happen and what happened instead.

## Environment

Include OS, Python version, package version/commit, adapter, and input format.

## Evidence-handling impact

Could this cause a missed/false match, lost provenance, unsafe output, or misleading report? Explain.
